title: genista tinctoria subsp. elatior
intro: Genista tinctoria subsp. elatior, commonly known as dyers greenweed, is a plant species in the legume family native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant has been traditionally used for its various health benefits, including its ability to support the immune system, reduce inflammation, and act as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Genista tinctoria subsp. elatior include its diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which help in relieving respiratory issues and promoting kidney function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
